ideas.title: Final Form: Can the Ball Reach Form 7?
ideas.hook: Frame 1: a small grey ball is already bouncing inside a glowing ring, with a yellow 'FORM 1/7' counter at the top
ideas.why: ASMR Ball Simulations' 'Can The Ball Reach Final Form' is at 122,773 views (9.4x its channel average) and the Lab lists it as a Bounce Theory lead. The tier-up counter gives a reason to wait for the last spectacle, the same payoff as your 107%-watched brick breaker, and your own 'ball gets BIGGER' sim hit 3,417 views. Test slot: it needs a new sims.py function (final_form), built from this spec.
ideas.format: Bounce Theory · Final Form ball evolution (new sims.py function final_form)
ideas.script: Build: new final_form() in sims.py. 1080x1920, 60 fps, near-black background, saturated glowing colours. One ball inside one white glowing ring (radius 400, centred x540 y820) with real gravity and bounce. Every 4th bounce the ball evolves to the next form with a flash and a rising tier-up sound: Form 1 grey (r 20), 2 brown (r 26), 3 orange + short trail (r 32), 4 yellow + longer trail (r 38), 5 cyan glow + spark trail (r 46), 6 magenta + comet trail (r 54), 7 FINAL FORM: gold core with rotating rainbow trail (r 62). Win: at bounce 28 the ball hits Form 7, the ring gets a rainbow outline burst, ball explodes into 200 particles that re-form the ball (loop ending: counter resets to FORM 1/7 and the ball is grey again at the last frame). Sound: one sine note per bounce stepping up a scale, a chime on each tier-up, a deep boom on Form 7. Length 28-32 s. Description: 'Can the ball reach its Final Form? 7 forms, one ring.' ideas.title: Spiral Chain Reaction (every wall hit splits)
ideas.hook: Frame 1: a single glowing white ball already rolling into the open mouth of a slowly rotating glowing spiral track.
ideas.why: GreyHaT Sim's 'Bouncing Emoji Balls Multiply in a Spiral!' has 3.95M views (12.6x). Your plain multiply Short ('1 ball becomes 200') got 2 views, so the multiply mechanic needs a new arena; the spiral gives it a visible goal (reach the centre).
ideas.script:
New sims.py function spiral_chain(). Arena: Archimedean spiral wall (r = 60 + 34·θ, 4.5 turns, line width 6) centred at (540, 900), rotating 0.35 rad/s; a glowing core circle r=45 at the centre. Start with 1 ball (r=14). Rule: every time a ball hits the spiral wall it splits into 2 (child gets ±15° velocity jitter), capped at 999 balls; ball radius shrinks from 14 to 6 as count grows. Gravity off; balls get a constant inward pull of 60 px/s² so they creep toward the core. Each ball's hue = its generation (rainbow cycle). Counter top-centre counts up. Win: first ball that touches the core triggers the core to flash and absorb all balls in a 2 s vacuum swirl. Looping ending: after the swirl, one white ball pops out of the core and flies back to the spiral mouth (= frame 1). On-screen lines (y=140-320): white 'Every hit = 2 balls', yellow 'Can 1 reach the centre? 🌀'; counter '1 → 999' at y≈1420. Sound: each split plays the next note of 'Ode to Joy' (public domain, synthesized bell timbre, max 12 notes/sec, gain rises with count); core hit = deep boom + whoosh. Background #06060b, spiral glow electric blue #3a7bff.
